adapters.name: Wildberries
adapters.scope: Seller Content, Prices, and Marketplace APIs. Card create and update are POST /content/v2/cards/upload and POST /content/v2/cards/update.

adapters.name: Ozon
adapters.scope: Seller API. Product create and update go through POST /v3/product/import. Prices, stocks, and orders use the methods in OzonApiClient.cs.

adapters.name: Yandex Market
adapters.scope: Partner API. Offers, cards, prices, and stocks use the /v2/businesses and /v2/campaigns methods in YandexMarketApiClient.cs.

adapters.name: OpenCart
adapters.scope: The plugin calls the Delegat bridge, not the stock OpenCart API. A release matters when it changes the extension system, catalog tables, or request routing that bridge is built on.

adapters.name: WooCommerce
adapters.scope: The plugin calls the Delegat bridge at wp-json/delegat/v1, not wc/v3 directly. A release matters when its REST, admin, or database notes would break that bridge. Posts titled What's coming are upcoming changes.

adapters.name: Medusa
adapters.scope: Medusa 2. The plugin calls the shop bridge /admin/delegat, not the stock Admin API. A release matters when its breaking changes, or the admin product, price, inventory, and order docs, would change that bridge.
